# Community Rule Column 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**7:1** Whoever lies concerning the-matter-of property, and he knows-it, they shall separate-him from the-pure-food-of the-Many for one year, and he shall be punished

**7:2** one-quarter of his food-ration. And whoever answers his neighbor with stubbornness-of-neck, or speaks with short-temper-of

**7:3** spirit, so-as-to reject the-foundation-of his associate who-is-inscribed before him, his own hand has delivered-him; he shall be punished

**7:4** for one year. And whoever mentions anything by-the-Name-that-is-honored-above-all — if he curses, whether when-struck-by

**7:5** distress, or for-any matter that-may-be upon-him, while-reading the-book or while-blessing, he shall be separated and shall not return

**7:6** again to the-council-of the-community. And if he spoke against one-of the-priests, those-inscribed

**7:7** in the-book, in-anger, he shall be punished for one year, and he shall be set-apart by-himself from the-pure-food-of

**7:8** the-Many. But if through-inadvertence he spoke, he shall be punished for six months. And whoever deliberately

**7:9** lies, he shall be punished for six months. And whoever insults his neighbor and-not

**7:10** with-justice, he shall be punished for one year, and he shall be set-apart. And whoever speaks to his neighbor with deceit

**7:11** or does-him-wrong knowingly — his punishment is six months. And if he-was-negligent

**7:12** concerning his neighbor, his punishment is three months. And whoever borrows from the-property-of

**7:13** his neighbor without-asking, his punishment is three months. And every man who bears-a-grudge

**7:14** against his neighbor and-not with-justice, he shall be punished for six months. And likewise whoever

**7:15** takes-vengeance for-himself in-any matter, his punishment is six months. Whoever speaks foolishness — three months. Whoever interrupts while-the-words-of

**7:16** his neighbor-are-still-being-spoken — ten days. And whoever lies-down and sleeps in the-session-of

**7:17** the-Many — thirty days. And likewise whoever leaves the-session-of the-Many without

**7:18** permission and without cause, up-to three times in one session, he shall be punished ten days. But if

**7:19** they-are-standing and he departs — thirty days. And whoever goes naked before

**7:20** his neighbor, not being compelled-to-do-so — six months. And the-man who spits in-the-midst-of the-session-of

**7:21** the-Many — thirty days. And whoever brings-out his left hand to-gesticulate

**7:22** with-it — ten days. And the-man who slanders his neighbor

**7:23** shall be set-apart from the-pure-food-of the-Many for one year, and he shall be punished. But the-man who slanders

**7:24** the-Many — he shall be expelled from-among-them and shall not return. And the-man who murmurs against

**7:25** the-authority-of the-community shall be expelled and shall not return.

---

*EMET notes: Column 7 preserves the Penal Code (serekh ha-'onashim) of the Qumran community. Hyphenated compounds reflect Hebrew construct chains and prepositional phrases. "The-Many" (ha-rabbim) is a sectarian self-designation for the full community assembly. "Pure-food" (tohorat) refers to ritually pure communal meals. Line numbers follow standard 1QS column divisions.*
